text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... That should do it for today.
I met my planned quota, but..."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I'm starting to see something.
If we could run side-by-side just a bit longer...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "Believe-san, you seem to have something on your mind."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "Let's do more! Even more!!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaah!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: You're jumping the gun, Right O! Calm down and converse properly.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Durandal-san, Right O-san...
If possible, I would like to do
just a bit more track work...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Still, it will likely lead to overwork...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—That's true. But depending on the situation,
there are times when you have to cross the line.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"All or nothing. Victory lies solely
beyond taking that risk—"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"So let's do even more!
Hyaaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "Calstone-san, don't talk while running!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Beyond the risk...
Can I... make it?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, um, I—
choice_data_list: I've just gotta grin and bear it here.
You've just gotta grin and bear it here.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, um, I—
choice_data_list: I've just gotta grin and bear it here.
You've just gotta grin and bear it here.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...?
Not you getting influenced by it too, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Though maybe momentum is important too.
Maybe today is just that kind of day...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Durandal-san, Right O-san,
well then, I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Let us find it.
Whatever lies beyond the boundary line, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Patience... That's right. So many Umamusume let their guard down thinking they're almost there, only to ruin themselves.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (To walk a long road, sometimes...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Durandal-san.
Though I think I'll pass for today.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I want to become a master craftsman just like my grandpa.
I look forward to working with you again tomorrow!
